description: SessionLikesStore is a singleton object that provides a global reset API used primarily by the playback menu. It contains an internal store instance, but the reset function currently does not perform any operation.

classes.name: SessionLikesStore
classes.description: An object providing a global endpoint for resetting session likes, mainly used by the playback menu. It contains a private in-memory rated store.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: A method intended to reset or clear the session's rated store; currently a no-operation placeholder.
